# Fase 33 etapa 9 (E1), whole gold since etapa 11 (G1): the reference price, one vector per case.
# The rule of every profession: the average contract of a tier is at least the dearest average
# contract of the tier below x step, and the reference is WHOLE gold (rounded up) and at least the
# dearest whole reference of the tier below + 1. Read by the Python reference tests (test_dish_price.py) and
# plugin-skse/tests/test_dish_price.cpp (HonestWorkDishTests); the Papyrus side is held to the
# same sum by the harness items PRC in HWTest_HonestWork.psc.
#
#   whole(x)  = max(1, ceil(x - 0.001)) for x > 0; 0 and negatives stay (the 0.001 keeps a figure
#               that is whole in exact arithmetic on the same side in float32 and float64)
#   ing       = whole(ingredient cost of one unit)            the ingredient input below is raw
#   average contract = (batchMin + batchMax) / 2 x (reference x mult + max(ing, 0))
#   reference = whole(max(game, ing x margin, (below x step / batch - ing) / mult))
#   reference = max(reference, dearest reference of the tier below + 1)         only with step > 0
#   below = the dearest average contract at the nearest lower rank (minContracts) of the profession
#   game <= 0: the reference is 0, as it is; ingredient < 0 (not resolved): whole(game), no ladder
#
# The expected values were worked out apart from the code under test (exact fractions, one line
# per task), not produced by it.
#
#   case <name>
#   task <minContracts> <game> <ingredientCost> <margin> <step> <batchMin> <batchMax> <mult>
#   expect <reference of each task, in the order listed>

# the four cook tasks, V071 figures: ingredients 5.44 / 7.66 / 23.2 / 10.5 are 6 / 8 / 24 / 11
case cook_defaults
task 0 4.56 5.44 1.2 1.15 4 6 1.4
task 5 6.98 7.66 1.2 1.15 3 5 1.4
task 15 4.6 23.2 1.2 1.15 2 3 1.4
task 30 3.0 10.5 1.2 1.15 1 2 1.4
expect 8 12 29 81

# the order of the list does not matter
case cook_listed_backwards
task 30 3.0 10.5 1.2 1.15 1 2 1.4
task 15 4.6 23.2 1.2 1.15 2 3 1.4
task 5 6.98 7.66 1.2 1.15 3 5 1.4
task 0 4.56 5.44 1.2 1.15 4 6 1.4
expect 81 29 12 8

# herbalist, V072 boot B: 1.65 / 1.9 per unit; rounded up the two lower tiers are 2 and 3
case herb_v072
task 0 1.65 0 0 1.15 10 16 1.9
task 5 1.9 0 0 1.15 8 12 1.9
task 15 8.0 0 0 1.15 3 6 1.9
expect 2 3 8

# two tasks at the lower rank: the dearest contract is the one to pass, and the tier above is
# one gold over the dearest whole reference (10), not equal to it
case same_rank_climbs_the_dearest
task 0 10 0 0 1.0 10 10 2.0
task 0 5 0 0 1.0 10 10 2.0
task 5 1 0 0 1.0 10 10 2.0
expect 10 5 11

# ranks 0 and 15, none at 5: the ladder gives 10, the +1 makes it 11
case gap_skips_to_the_nearest_lower_rank
task 0 10 0 0 1.0 10 10 2.0
task 15 1 0 0 1.0 10 10 2.0
expect 10 11

# each tier climbs over the one already climbed (15 x 1.5 = 22.5 rounds up to 23)
case chain_of_three
task 0 10 0 0 1.5 10 10 1.0
task 5 1 0 0 1.5 10 10 1.0
task 15 1 0 0 1.5 10 10 1.0
expect 10 15 23

# step 0 switches the ladder off, and the +1 with it
case step_off_keeps_the_game_value
task 0 10 0 0 0 10 10 2.0
task 5 1 0 0 0 10 10 2.0
expect 10 1

# a game value already above the floor stays
case never_below_the_game_value
task 0 10 0 0 1.0 10 10 2.0
task 5 50 0 0 1.0 10 10 2.0
expect 10 50

# no value in this game: no reference and no contract to climb
case game_zero_stays_zero_and_counts_nothing
task 0 0 0 0 1.0 10 10 2.0
task 5 3 0 0 1.0 10 10 2.0
expect 0 3

# ingredient -1: the game value (whole), no ladder for it; the contract above climbs over that
# (4.56 -> 5, contract 5 x (5 x 1.4) = 35; the dish above is held by its ingredients: 8 x 1.2 = 9.6 -> 10)
case ingredient_not_resolved_is_off
task 0 4.56 -1 1.2 1.15 4 6 1.4
task 5 6.98 7.66 1.2 1.15 3 5 1.4
expect 5 10

# a multiplier of 0 leaves no unit to solve for, but the +1 only asks for the step
case multiplier_zero_keeps_the_plus_one
task 0 10 0 0 1.0 10 10 0.0
task 5 1 0 0 1.0 10 10 0.0
expect 10 11

# the unit is solved net of the ingredients: 70 x 1.0 / 5 = 14, less 3 = 11, over 2 = 5.5 -> 6
case ingredients_enter_the_contract_at_cost
task 0 2 3 0 1.0 10 10 2.0
task 5 1 3 0 1.0 5 5 2.0
expect 2 6

# two levels that tie after the rounding: 5 x 1 x 1 = 5 is the contract to pass, the unit
# solved is 5, the tier above is 6, and the next one 7
case plus_one_when_two_tiers_tie
task 0 5 0 0 1.0 1 1 1.0
task 5 1 0 0 1.0 1 1 1.0
task 15 1 0 0 1.0 1 1 1.0
expect 5 6 7

# the ladder by the contract is already above the +1: it stays (5 x 2.0 = 10)
case ladder_above_the_plus_one_stays
task 0 5 0 0 2.0 1 1 1.0
task 5 1 0 0 2.0 1 1 1.0
expect 5 10

# both tasks of a level climb over the dearest of the level below
case every_task_of_a_level_climbs
task 0 5 0 0 1.0 1 1 1.0
task 5 1 0 0 1.0 1 1 1.0
task 5 2 0 0 1.0 1 1 1.0
expect 5 6 6

# rounding up, ladder off: 1.01 -> 2; 2.0004 stays 2 (inside the 0.001); 2.002 -> 3; 0.2 -> 1; 7 stays 7
case rounds_up_to_whole_gold
task 0 1.01 0 0 0 1 1 1.0
task 5 2.0004 0 0 0 1 1 1.0
task 15 2.002 0 0 0 1 1 1.0
task 30 0.2 0 0 0 1 1 1.0
task 50 7 0 0 0 1 1 1.0
expect 2 2 3 1 7

# the ingredient is rounded up BEFORE the margin: 2.2 -> 3, 3 x 1.2 = 3.6 -> 4 (not 2.2 x 1.2 = 2.64 -> 3)
case ingredient_rounds_up_before_the_margin
task 0 1 2.2 1.2 0 1 1 1.0
expect 4

# an ingredient already whole stays: 5 x 1.2 = 6 is exactly 6, not 7
case whole_ingredient_stays
task 0 1 5 1.2 0 1 1 1.0
expect 6
